name: Tilkett Halmshaw
original_name: ティルケット・ハルムショー
source:
[i]"I'm ignoring ethics, saying my farewells to morality... Even if society turns on me, I'm going to make whatever decision doesn't leave me with regrets."[/i]

[i]Altruist Who Elevates Pain[/i]

A cheerful and light-hearted young doctor. He's never without a friendly smile, but he's actually a former delinquent. Even now that he's turned over a new leaf, his old life still peeks through in some of his mannerisms.

His Gift gives him control of his own blood, allowing him to both heal and harm with it. Though his powers require self-injury, he doesn't hesitate at the pain. If anything, the elation he feels at helping others harbors a hidden danger.

The heroine's parents supported the orphanage he lived at, so he knows who she is. The admiration he felt for her then is just as strong now, and he yields all too easily to her fake smile or crocodile tears. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=tilkett]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
